steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Set the event type to RFQ and retain the single-vendor lot awarding mode.
Provide the required event title so the create flow is valid.
Choose the available RFQ pricing template.
Add the specified product with quantity 10.
Confirm the requested product produced one line item before opening Participants.
Open the Participants control whose behavior is under test.
Verify that the All Vendors window opens.
Verify the vendor search field is present.
Verify the Filters button is present.
Verify the Cancel button is present.
Verify the Save button is present.
Confirm the event still shows one line item after the window opens.
